name: sched_getparam
description: sched_getparam() retrieves the scheduling parameters for the thread identified by pid. If pid is zero, it retrieves the parameters of the calling thread.

parameters.name: pid
parameters.description: The thread ID, or 0 for the calling thread.

parameters.name: param
parameters.description: Pointer to a struct sched_param to store the retrieved scheduling parameters.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: Invalid arguments: param is NULL or pid is negative
The thread whose ID is pid could not be found
